name: spectral representation
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 通过频率成分及其幅相信息表示随机过程的方法。
usage_overview: 用于依据演化功率谱构造随机地震时程，将地震动的频域描述转化为时域激励，为车辆—轨道耦合系统的随机动力分析提供输入。

complete_examples.text: In this model, the earthquake is expressed as non-stationary random process simulated by spectral representation and random function, and the track random irregularities with ergodic properties on amplitudes, wavelengths and probabilities are characterized by a track irregularity probabilistic model, and then the number theoretical method (NTM) is applied to effectively select representative samples of earthquakes and track random irregularities.
